Small Size. Big Performance.

Tough Enough for the Job, Simple Enough for Anyone to Use.

The 2024 KIOTI CX2510H is a reliable and easy-to-use compact tractor built for versatility, comfort, and power in a smaller frame. With 25 HP under the hood and a smooth hydrostatic transmission, this model is perfect for homeowners, small farms, and light commercial work. Whether you’re mowing, moving dirt, or running attachments, the CX2510H gives you the performance you need in a compact and operator-friendly package.

Features may include:

Dependable 25 HP Diesel Engine
The fuel-efficient KIOTI 3-cylinder engine provides quiet, steady power for everyday work.

Hydrostatic Transmission
Dual pedal HST gives smooth forward and reverse control—ideal for loader and yard work.

3-Point Hitch Capability
Category I hitch with 1,203 lbs lift capacity lets you run rotary cutters, box blades, tillers, and more.

Independent PTO
540 RPM PTO with simple electric engagement supports a wide range of implements.

Operator Comfort
ROPS station with suspension seat, flat deck, and ergonomic control layout for an enjoyable ride.

Hydraulic Power
Dual remotes and 12.5 GPM total hydraulic flow for responsive loader and implement performance.

Power Steering & 4WD
Standard features that make maneuvering in tight spaces or tough terrain easy and efficient.
